2608.27455.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
2608.27455.paper_summary: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL
2608.27455.paper_summary_zh: 最近在推理時間擴展方面的進展顯著提高了大型語言模型（LLMs）的推理性能。<lb/>然而，這些方法通常依賴於重複生成或外部驗證。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們引入了CritICL，一種新穎的推理時間框架，它在保持高效率的同時改善推理。<lb/>我們的關鍵見解是，LLM的失敗模式在同一家族的模型規模中展現出結構化的模式。<lb/>CritICL不將失敗視為不理想的輸出，而是將其作為指導的來源。<lb/>具體而言，我們利用來自較弱模型的失敗模式，並通過基於評價的上下文示例將其納入推理中。<lb/>我們提出了兩個變體：CritICL-dynamic，該變體自適應地預測特定輸入的失敗模式並檢索評價；以及CritICL-static，該變體使用全局失敗模式概況提供穩定的指導。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，CritICL始終優於標準的上下文學習，並且在性能上與測試時間擴展方法競爭或更優，同時所需的生成次數顯著較少，令牌成本也較低。<lb/>代碼可在以下鏈接獲得：https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL
